227	// the caller-supplied filter, which encodes the compaction flow's notion of "matching series".
228	type headSelectedSeriesIndexReader struct {
229		*headIndexReader
230		selectedSeriesRefs seriesRefs
231	}

233	type allSelectedSeriesPostings struct{ index.Postings }

235	func (h *headSelectedSeriesIndexReader) Postings(ctx context.Context, name string, values ...string) (index.Postings, error) {
236		if len(h.selectedSeriesRefs.sortedByRef) == 0 {
237			return index.EmptyPostings(), nil
238		}
239	
240		selectedSeriesPostings := index.NewListPostings(h.selectedSeriesRefs.sortedByRef)
241		// This method is only expected to be called during compaction from the AllSortedPostings, with AllPostingsKey.
242		// The result of this method will be passed to SortedPostings().
243		// In order to avoid sorting head twice, but still return the correct results, we return a postings type with a marker here.
244		// This marker will be used by SortedPostings to swap the full postings by the ones sorted by labels.
245		// However, the results is still valid to be used as normal postings as well.
246		if k, v := index.AllPostingsKey(); name == k && len(values) == 1 && values[0] == v {
247			return allSelectedSeriesPostings{selectedSeriesPostings}, nil
248		}
249	
250		// This is not expected to be used, as headSelectedSeriesIndexReader is only expected to be used during compaction.
251		return index.Intersect(selectedSeriesPostings, h.head.postings.Postings(ctx, name, values...)), nil
252	}
253	
254	func (h *headSelectedSeriesIndexReader) PostingsForLabelMatching(ctx context.Context, name string, match func(string) bool) index.Postings {
255		// This is not expected to be used, as headSelectedSeriesIndexReader is only expected to be used during compaction.
256		return index.Intersect(
257			index.NewListPostings(h.selectedSeriesRefs.sortedByRef),
258			h.head.postings.PostingsForLabelMatching(ctx, name, match),
259		)
260	}
261	
262	func (h *headSelectedSeriesIndexReader) PostingsForAllLabelValues(ctx context.Context, name string) index.Postings {
263		// This is not expected to be used, as headSelectedSeriesIndexReader is only expected to be used during compaction.
264		return index.Intersect(
265			index.NewListPostings(h.selectedSeriesRefs.sortedByRef),
266			h.head.postings.PostingsForAllLabelValues(ctx, name),
267		)
268	}

units.summary: New test helper that opens a DB with compactions disabled, appends totalSeries series with samplesPerSeries samples inside one 1s range, and returns the head refs. It runs only in tests and benchmarks.
units.headline: Add benchmark helper that builds a head with N in-order series
units.reason: Test-only helper in a _test.go file; no production impact.

units.summary: New benchmark that rebuilds a 100k-series DB on each iteration and times CompactSelectedSeries over selection fractions from 100% down to 0.1%. Setup and close run with the timer stopped. The comment saying selected series cannot be reused holds, because the evicted series are gone from the head.
units.headline: Benchmark CompactSelectedSeries across selection fractions
units.reason: New benchmark only; cannot affect production behavior.

units.summary: New public DB method. It filters the caller's refs down to series that exist in the head and have no out-of-order data, writes one block per chunk range through compactHeadViewLocked tagged with the SelectedSeries hint, then evicts those series from the head without moving HeadMinTime. It also records triggered, failed and duration metrics.

issues.title: num_skipped_ooo also counts unknown refs
issues.failure_scenario: The caller passes refs that were already garbage-collected from the head. filterSeriesAndSortPostings drops them as not found, but the log reports them under num_skipped_ooo, which misleads operators about how much out-of-order data there is.

units.headline: New CompactSelectedSeries writes blocks for chosen series and evicts them
units.reason: New public API that persists blocks and deletes head series under the compaction lock.
focus: Caller-supplied refs may be unsorted or duplicated: sortedByRef keeps input order, and a duplicated ref appears twice in sortedByLabels when the index is written
Eviction safety when isolation is disabled: hasAppendIDAbove does nothing, so concurrent appends to selected series can be lost
Interaction with the WAL checkpoint and walExpiries for evicted refs while HeadMinTime is not advanced
The failed metric is incremented through the named err return; check that every error path sets it

units.summary: New happy-path test. It checks that selected non-stale series are evicted, the stale counter is untouched, HeadMinTime stays put, the block carries the hint, and the metrics are correct.
units.headline: Test happy path of CompactSelectedSeries

units.summary: New test confirming that nil or empty ref lists are no-ops: no block is written and the triggered metric is not incremented.
units.headline: Test empty ref list is a no-op

units.summary: New test confirming that a series spanning two chunk ranges produces two blocks, each carrying the selected-series hint, and that the series is evicted afterwards.
units.headline: Test one block per chunk range for selected series
